subtitle: Manage your personal preferences and system settings
page_subtitle: Manage personal, teaching, and system settings based on your permissions.

profile.title: Personal profile
profile.description: These contact details belong to your personal profile. Your sign-in email stays separate.

security.title: Account security
security.description: Change your sign-in email or password. Your current password is required to verify your identity.
security.email_confirmation_hint: A confirmation link will be sent to the new email address. It will become your sign-in email after confirmation.
security.password_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
security.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
security.request_failed: The change could not be completed. Please try again.
security.email_confirmation_sent: A confirmation link has been sent to the new email address.

timezone.title: Time Zone Settings
timezone.description: Configure the time zone used for displaying times. This affects your class schedule, report times, and all time-related features.
timezone.search_placeholder: Search region or city (e.g., Taipei, London, UTC...)

appearance.title: Appearance & Personalization
appearance.description: Customize how the interface looks for a more comfortable experience.
appearance.font_scale_hint: Changes will be applied immediately to all pages.

teacher_roles.title: Teacher Role Types
teacher_roles.description: Manage roles available for class assignments. Built-in roles cannot be removed.

teaching_role_permissions.title: Teaching Role Permissions
teaching_role_permissions.description: Manage teaching role access to student, teacher, classroom, class-session, attendance, report, holiday and enrollment operations at teaching and classroom scopes. System administration permissions are managed separately.

incomplete_notifications.title: Incomplete Report Notifications
incomplete_notifications.description: Choose which assigned roles receive incomplete-report reminders on the dashboard.
incomplete_notifications.inheritance_hint: Each role uses the most specific class, classroom, then system policy. A deny on any assigned role takes priority.

dashboard_schedule.title: Today's Schedule Visibility
dashboard_schedule.description: Choose, for each teaching role, which classes appear in the dashboard's today's schedule. Classrooms and classes can override this in Classroom management. System roles do not affect the schedule.
dashboard_schedule.inheritance_hint: Each role uses its most specific setting (class, then classroom, then system). When a user has several teaching roles, the strictest explicit setting wins: Hidden, then Assigned classes only, then All classes.
dashboard_schedule.scope_hint: Choose which classes each teaching role sees in today's schedule here. Inherit uses the classroom or system setting.

extension.title: Browser extension connections
extension.description: Manage EduLog access for each browser installation. Different computers or browser profiles have separate connections. An extension ID identifies the product, not a device.
extension.load_failed: Could not load extension connection settings.
extension.pair_description: Only approve if you just started this pairing in the EduLog extension. The extension will be able to use its integration features for this account.
extension.approved: Extension connection approved. Return to the extension to finish pairing.
extension.approve_failed: Could not approve this request. It may have expired or already been used.
extension.connected_notice: Pairing completed. The connection is now listed.
extension.name_required: Enter a connection name of 1–80 characters.
extension.waiting_claim: Approved — waiting for the extension to finish pairing
extension.name: Connection name
extension.name_hint: Use a computer or context name, such as “Classroom laptop · Chrome”, to identify and revoke it.
extension.pair_expired: This pairing request expired or is unavailable. Start pairing again in the extension.
extension.legacy_hint: This older authorization has no browser installation information. Its extension ID cannot identify a device. Rename it, or recheck the connection in that browser to add installation details.
extension.rename_failed: Could not update the connection name. Try again.
extension.revoke_confirm: This removes EduLog access for “{name}” (connection {id}). That browser must pair again to use integrations. The Clear theme remains available.
